1	// components/navigation/overlay-layers.ts — Unified Overlay Stacking Hierarchy
2	// Establishes a predictable, collision-free z-index hierarchy across the entire XEURIE architecture.
3	// Strict stacking ensures modals, slide-overs, dropdowns, and toasts never collide or occlude incorrectly.
4	
5	export const OVERLAY_LAYERS = {
6	  /** Sticky header chrome and navigation bars */
7	  HEADER: "z-30",
8	
9	  /** Account menus, route dropdowns, and flyout popovers */
10	  DROPDOWN: "z-40",
11	
12	  /** Full-viewport mobile navigation drawers (backdrop & sheet) */
13	  MOBILE_DRAWER: "z-50",
14	
15	  /** Standard dialogs, checkout flow, restock alert, legal terms */
16	  MODAL: "z-[60]",
17	
18	  /** Critical security confirmation modals (pre-payment, emergency) */
19	  CRITICAL_MODAL: "z-[80]",
20	
21	  /** Customer Vault slide-over drawer (preserved contract: z-[100] backdrop, z-[101] sheet) */
22	  VAULT_BACKDROP: "z-[100]",
23	  VAULT_DRAWER: "z-[101]",
24	
25	  /** Portaled select dropdowns, contextual popovers (rendered above modals & drawers) */
26	  POPOVER: "z-[105]",
27	
28	  /** Global feedback toasts & realtime telemetry notices (always topmost) */
29	  TOAST: "z-[110]",
30	} as const;
31	
32	export type OverlayLayerKey = keyof typeof OVERLAY_LAYERS;
33

content.text:
The module is `components/navigation/overlay-layers.ts`. It exports `OVERLAY_LAYERS`, a map of Tailwind class strings such as `"z-[60]"`, and the `OverlayLayerKey` type.

Five source files import it:
- `components/ui/select.tsx:6`
- `components/ui/modal.tsx:19`
- `components/ui/combobox.tsx:25`
- `components/navigation/shared-mobile-drawer.tsx:12`
- `components/navigation/account-menu.tsx:25`

One test also imports it: `test/phase-5a-navigation-shell.test.ts:10`. It probably asserts specific layer values, so check it after you change one.

- **Pages:** Many admin and portal pages only reach the layers through `ui/modal`, `ui/select` or `ui/combobox`. They don't import the module themselves.
- **Docs:** The hits in `llms-full.txt` and `XNIGHT_T00_UI_Coverage_Register.md` are documentation, not code.
- **Hardcoded z-indexes:** I only searched for the module name. A file that hardcodes a `z-[...]` class without importing the module won't show up here. `components/public/background-music-player.tsx` matched an earlier search on z-index and overlay terms but doesn't import the module, so it may hardcode its own value.
- **Vault drawer:** The comment on `VAULT_BACKDROP` and `VAULT_DRAWER` says their values (`z-[100]` and `z-[101]`) are a preserved contract. I didn't find a file that uses those two keys. Before changing them, search for literal `z-[100]` and `z-[101]`.

Because Tailwind scans for literal class strings, any new value has to stay a complete string in that file, for example `"z-[70]"`. Building it dynamically won't generate the class.

I can search for hardcoded `z-[` values elsewhere if you want.
